explicitExclusions.reason: Third-party installed dependency sources were outside the offline product-source audit.
Compiled Rust build outputs were not source review targets.
Generated frontend bundles were covered through their source files.
Bundled application copies duplicate reviewed source/resources and contain compiled artifacts.
Tauri-generated schemas were treated as generated build metadata.
Binary and vector application icon assets contain no executable product logic.
Generated visual regression images and reports contain no executable product logic.

surfaces.label: Tauri IPC commands and SQLite persistence
surfaces.notes: Queries use static SQL and positional parameters; database location is fixed under app data. Arbitrary renderer-path concerns lacked an independently reachable renderer attacker and raw-file exfiltration.
surfaces.riskArea: Native command exposure, SQL injection, path handling, database integrity

surfaces.label: Audio picker, renderer ingestion, and browser decoding
surfaces.notes: Whole-file reads, decoding, and duration-dependent analysis lack centralized resource bounds.
surfaces.riskArea: Untrusted media parsing and resource exhaustion

surfaces.label: Rust-to-Python Basic Pitch subprocess
surfaces.notes: Shell injection was rejected because arguments are passed without a shell; runtime and output remain unbounded.
surfaces.riskArea: Process execution, media parsing, CPU/memory/output bounds

surfaces.label: Microphone capture and MediaRecorder lifecycle
surfaces.notes: Explicit Stop releases tracks, but unmount and setup failure do not.

surfaces.label: Blob URL and AudioContext ownership
surfaces.notes: Import URLs are replaced without revocation and failed analysis bypasses AudioContext.close.

surfaces.label: React rendering, CSP, and remote-content exposure
surfaces.notes: CSP is disabled as defense-in-depth debt, but no remote content source, navigation route, network client, innerHTML/eval sink, or unsafe React rendering path was found.

surfaces.label: Dialog and filesystem capability scope
surfaces.notes: The normal flow is user initiated and capability is local-window only. The custom Basic Pitch command accepts a path, but no realistic independent attacker route to renderer execution or raw-file disclosure was established.

surfaces.label: Export, local state, and song metadata
surfaces.notes: React escapes strings, export is browser-managed, SQLite uses parameters, and no secrets or network tokens were present.
surfaces.riskArea: Path traversal, persistent injection, and sensitive-data exposure
